en: The Sūtra on the Treatment of Hemorrhoids Spoken by the Buddha, translated by the Tripitaka Master Yijing of the Great Tang, by imperial decree.
Thus have I heard: At one time, the Bhagavān was staying at the Bamboo Grove Monastery in the great city of Rājagṛha.
There, he was together with a great assembly of five hundred bhikṣus.
At that time, there were many bhikṣus who suffered from hemorrhoids; their bodies were emaciated and they were wracked by intense suffering, experiencing extreme distress day and night.
At that time, the Venerable Ānanda, having witnessed this event, went to where the World-Honored One was, prostrated at his feet, stood to one side, and said:
"World-Honored One!"
Currently, in the city of Rājagṛha, there are many bhikṣus suffering from hemorrhoids; their bodies are emaciated and they are writhing in pain, experiencing extreme distress day and night.
“World-Honored One!
How should these hemorrhoids be treated?
The Buddha told Ānanda:

“You should listen to this *Sūtra on the Treatment of Hemorrhoids*, read, recite, and uphold it; fix your mind upon it without forgetting, and also proclaim it extensively for others. Then all these hemorrhoids will be completely cured.”
That is to say:

wind-piles, heat-piles, phlegm-piles, those caused by the combination of the three humors, blood-piles, internal abdominal piles, nasal piles, dental piles, lingual piles, ocular piles, auricular piles, cranial piles, piles of the hands and feet, piles of the spine and back, anal piles... all the various piles arising from every limb and joint—such fistulas and hemorrhoids shall all be dried up, fallen away, and extinguished, and there is no doubt they will be completely cured.
"All should recite and uphold this divine mantra.
He then spoke the mantra, saying:
"Tadyathā | Kere | Śrī | Śrī | Mākāśiti | Samarddhu | Svāhā. Regarding this mantra, the Danzang states:
“Tadyathā | A-raṇte | A-raṇ-me | Śrī-vi | Śri-śri | Ma-kad-ci-t | Saṃ-bha-da-u | Svāhā. “Ānanda!
To the north of here lies the Great Snowy Mountain King.
Within it stands a great śāla tree named "Invincible.
Upon it grow three kinds of flowers:
First is the initial growth, second is full development, and third is withering and decay.

Just as that flower, when it dries up and falls, so too are my hemorrhoids: may there be no more bleeding, may there be no more pus flowing; may the pain be forever eliminated and all become completely dry.
Furthermore, those who constantly recite this sutra shall attain the knowledge of past lives and be able to remember the events of seven previous births.
May the dhāraṇī method be accomplished! Svāhā!
Furthermore, he spoke this mantra:

"Tadyathā | jami | jami | śamijami | jamuni | śamuni | svāhā. When the Buddha had finished speaking this sutra, the Venerable Ānanda and the great assembly were all filled with great joy; they believed, accepted, and practiced it accordingly.
The Sutra Spoken by the Buddha on the Treatment of Hemorrhoids (Arśas)
